connector.name: Gold MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for XAUUSD gold market data + 4-tier trading toolkit (TA, backtest, SMC, risk).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gold-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thaitrevor account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOLD_MCP_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: Optional Ed25519 license token. Unlocks Pro/Premium/Ultra tools. Buy at pthaicapital.io.vn/mcp/

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional (Ultra AI Analyst only). BYOK Claude API key for ai_daily_briefing / ai_setup_explanation.
